annotations.title: IBC test and inspection due dates

description:
Work out when an IBC (intermediate bulk container) is due for its leakproofness test and its 2.5-year and 5-year inspections, the last month it may be filled and, for plastic and composite IBCs, the end of its five-year life.
Use when: the user asks whether an IBC is in date or may still be filled. Instead: decode_un_packaging_mark to read the rest of an IBC mark; bund_size to size spill containment under IBCs.
Inputs: mark alone is enough, since the code and month of manufacture are read from it. Otherwise send made, plus code if known; without code a composite 31HA1 tote is assumed. leak and insp move the due dates on from the last test; without them every date counts from manufacture. bottle restarts the five-year life of a remanufactured composite. A full date is read only when its day cannot be mistaken for the month. regime=us has no five-year life.
Behaviour: dates are judged against the current month, so the same IBC moves from ok to soon to overdue as time passes. Every default is listed in assumed; an unreadable date or code returns ok:false.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.

bottle.description: Month the inner receptacle was replaced, for remanufactured composite IBCs

code.description: IBC code when no mark is given, e.g. 31HA1 (composite), 31H1 (rigid plastic), 31A (steel)

insp.description: Month of the last inspection, same formats. Usually the same month as leak

leak.description: Month of the last leakproofness test, same formats

mark.description: The IBC UN mark from the plate; the code and month of manufacture are read from it, e.g. "31HA1/Y/03 22/D/BAM 12345/10800/1200"

regime.description: un: UN Model Regulations and ADR (default). us: 49 CFR 180.352

repair.description: Month of the last repair, if any

name: ibc_inspection_dates

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

end_of_use.description: MM/YYYY, for plastic and composite IBCs; null where no limit applies

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

fill_only_before.description: MM/YYYY: the IBC may be filled up to the end of the month before this

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

status.description: ok, soon (under three months to the last fill) or overdue

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

title: IBC test and inspection due dates
